title: Demonic Warrior Queen
description: A female demon with black horns, large black feathered wings, and a revealing black and red armored outfit stands dynamically amid a battlefield of skulls and fallen swords. She wields a massive glowing pink magical sword in one hand while casting a swirling blue energy spell with the other, surrounded by red and pink flames, floating hearts, and dark smoky atmosphere.
prompt: A striking female demon warrior with black curved horns, long dark hair, and large black feathered wings stands in a dramatic pose on a battlefield covered in skulls and broken swords. She wears ornate black and red armor with white fur trim and a revealing bodice, holding a massive glowing pink magical sword in her right hand while her left hand casts a swirling blue and purple energy spell. Red and pink flames and embers swirl around her, with floating pink hearts near her head, set against a dark smoky background, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
